failedTest.preservedHarnessCorrection: The first run was 0/8 because the provenance assertion failed across a Markdown line break. The assertion was corrected to permit whitespace; the rerun passed the provenance case and retained seven product failures.

summary.reason: Passing inherited copy/accessibility tests omitted persisted bytes, direct builder calls, live receipt semantics, spoiler-bearing publications, destructive truncation, and several Catalysis/fictional-seat boundaries.

findings.title: Pre-completion save text exposes sealed linguistic and analytic state
findings.issue: Schema 1 serializes the complete NightState into inspectable portable text and browser slots.
findings.constraint: Persistence may preserve a playable path without publishing repertoire IDs, switch rationale, relational analysis, diversion motive, framework analysis, last-resort interior, or revealed route copy before turn 24.
findings.observed: A one-decision save includes payload.state, activeCodeId, complete decision records, effects, and conclusion-gated copy fields.
findings.reproduction: Run the pre-completion save-byte case in tests/linguistics-contract.test.mjs.
findings.designDecision: Replace complete-state persistence with a schema-2 minimal replay trace and reconstruct all derived state.

findings.title: Live direct-layer copy overclaims selected carriage
findings.issue: The visible branch checks only layer=direct and says a crossing followed the event label.
findings.constraint: Event kind, semantic, selectedCarriage, and applied/background/avoided reach must independently govern the sentence.
findings.observed: Background-only decisions and autonomous pulses on direct links can be narrated as selected crossings; format and content are not discriminated.
findings.reproduction: Run the live crossing semantic branch case in tests/linguistics-contract.test.mjs.
findings.designDecision: Introduce explicit decision/autonomous and content/format/ambient/background/avoided branches.

findings.title: Conclusion builders disclose later material when called on an unfinished night
findings.issue: The JSX is gated, but the pure exported builders are not.
findings.constraint: The disclosure boundary belongs inside every derivation that can produce conclusion copy.
findings.observed: buildNaturalizedSummary(generateScenarioPack(0), createNightState(pack)) returns a later-resolution paragraph at turn 0.
findings.reproduction: Run the incomplete-night builder case in tests/linguistics-contract.test.mjs.
findings.designDecision: Return empty typed derivations unless isNightComplete(state) is true.

findings.title: The pre-completion House Guide embeds spoiler-bearing research publications
findings.issue: ResearchRecordLinks and its iframe render before completion, and an inherited test positively requires that access.
findings.constraint: Operational guidance may remain available; analytic taxonomies and full model publications follow the conclusion gate.
findings.observed: The notes drawer links Model Specification, Research Design, Systems Atlas, Verification Ledger, and the notebook index before turn 24.
findings.reproduction: Inspect HouseDrawer or run the research-record gate case.
findings.designDecision: Render ResearchRecordLinks only when analysisAvailable and update the conflicting accessibility contract.

findings.title: Active choice details repeat sealed motive instead of trusting subtext
findings.issue: Concrete omission copy is followed by explicit protected-relationship and protected-interest analysis.
findings.constraint: The player may see the fictional seat's known record and available omission without receiving the lesson label or repeated motive essay.
findings.observed: Generated detail says the seat's record shows who changed the handoff and that leaving it out protects a named interest.
findings.designDecision: Keep the concrete action and omission; remove the appended analytic explanation from active detail.

findings.title: Invitation copy assigns the player a fictional interior in second person
findings.issue: Rendered mentality and incident-connection strings use You/your for authored motives and stakes.
findings.constraint: Close focalization belongs to the named fictional seat and must not be grammatically attached to the real player.
findings.observed: Examples include 'You treat omission as a practical risk' and 'Your audience values speed'.
findings.designDecision: Rewrite mentality and incident connection in explicit third-person seat language.

findings.title: Length bounding amputates protected causal propositions
findings.issue: shortFragment and boundedParagraph insert ellipses mid-party, benefit, harm, and self-cost.
findings.constraint: A last-resort passage may be concise, but every represented protected party, benefit, harmed party, harm, and self-cost must remain a complete recoverable proposition.
findings.observed: Seed 0 produced 'it protected the person framed by… as mirrors receive the attributable…' and incomplete harm clauses.
findings.reproduction: Run the natural-summary causal-clause case for seed 0.
findings.designDecision: Select complete clauses and stop truncating generated sentences after assembly.

findings.title: Text-label deduplication invents identity between independent decisions
findings.issue: Normalized label text is treated as event identity across rooms.
findings.constraint: Only decision and room identities can establish that two references are the same enacted move.
findings.observed: A generic label selected in another room becomes 'the earlier named move from [room]', implying transfer that the ledger does not establish.
findings.reproduction: Generate completed summaries across repeated-label seeds and inspect the alias phrase.
findings.designDecision: Scope label reuse to the same scenario and use a neutral same-room reference.

findings.title: Guide and fixed trace make stale or unsupported ending promises
findings.issue: HouseGuide promises an authored-interior reveal absent from the new ending; MemeLineage has no pack/state but is presented as a trace after play.
findings.constraint: Utility guidance must describe current behavior, and general examples must not masquerade as played evidence.
findings.observed: The guide says the final receipt reveals authored interior; the fixed trace has no general-reference label.
findings.reproduction: Run the spoiler-bearing research/guide source contract.
findings.designDecision: Promise only a state-supported ending and label the fixed lineage as a general reference.

findings.title: The earlier copy evidence lacks its promised stable atom inventory
findings.issue: The baseline record lists coarse paths and surfaces rather than stable atom IDs, classes, propositions, disclosure phases, and owners.
findings.constraint: Completion claims require traceability from exact output atoms to requirements and evidence.
findings.observed: CHR-COPY-PROV/SEQ/SEM rows remain pending while implementation had already advanced.
findings.reproduction: Inspect evidence/copy/copy-baseline.4fffddf.v1.json and the copy register statuses.
findings.designDecision: Add the dedicated linguistic register, evidence schema, and executable cross-channel contracts; do not relabel the coarse baseline as a complete atom inventory.

findings.title: Summary and generated choice language remain mechanically repetitive
findings.issue: A small set of templates repeats across roles, incidents, scenes, and summary transitions.
findings.constraint: Determinism may use authored grammar, but cadence and phrasing must respond to the concrete incident and causal shape rather than advertise the template.
findings.observed: A 100-seed audit found 42 distinct labels and 110 details across 7,548 choices; five labels appeared 600 times each. Summary transitions repeatedly use 'selected move' and 'The next selected move'.
findings.reproduction: Generate 100 seeds and count normalized label/detail/summary-transition strings.
findings.designDecision: Correct the most visible summary transition saturation now and retain broader authored-copy diversity as an explicit post-correction editorial gate rather than claiming corpus uniqueness.

findings.title: Passing inherited suites omit the channels where failures occur
findings.issue: Copy, accessibility, viewport, save, and runtime suites passed while disclosure and causal failures remained reproducible.
findings.constraint: No completion claim may substitute source-regex or happy-path tests for persisted bytes, direct APIs, typed route branches, and browser/assistive output.
findings.observed: Inherited focused suites passed; the new cross-channel suite passed 1/8 and failed 7/8 after its harness correction.
findings.reproduction: Compare baseline focused results with failedTest in this record.
findings.designDecision: Add tests/linguistics-contract.test.mjs to normal and release workflows and renew final evidence only after corrections stabilize.

findings.title: Current public evidence remains bound to the earlier generator and test count
findings.issue: Published working-tree status still names generator 13, 80 tests, and an earlier implementation digest while the linguistic work uses generator 14 and additional suites.
findings.constraint: Historical evidence remains historical; final claims require one renewed implementation binding.
findings.observed: docs/status drift checks fail and release remains held.
findings.reproduction: Run npm run docs:check:working-tree and npm run status:check on the pre-correction binding.
findings.designDecision: Regenerate publications and status only after the final linguistic correction and full test pass.
